preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalnum() or c.isspace() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s contains only English letters, digits, and spaces.
The input string s contains at least one alphanumeric character.

postconditions.expression: return_value == ' '.join(word for word in s.split() if word)[::-1]
postconditions.description: The output string is the words in the input string s in reverse order, separated by a single space.
